title: PSG
body:
**Programmable Sound Generator**: a chip that generates tones itself rather than playing
back samples. You write a [[Frequency]] and an [[Amplitude]] into its registers and it
produces a square wave on one of its channels until told otherwise, plus usually a noise
channel for percussion and effects.

Cheap, because it needs no sample data and almost no [[CPU]] time, which is why it is what
8-bit and 16-bit machines used. The Atari ST's is the [[YM2149]], three tone channels plus
noise. The contrast is [[PCM]], where the waveform is stored rather than synthesised.
